name: Published privacy service prices and scopes
description: First-party published options checked on October 24, 2026. GLP writes the best-for judgments. Missing coverage is not a negative coverage claim.
scope: Published first-party price and scope evidence for the named subscription, family, concierge and free options. Unestablished features are explicit unknowns, not negative findings.

changelog.change: First edition from current first-party sources.
Added current DeleteMe cost evidence, Optery adult and family options, and current Incogni Concierge staff scope. No personal flow tested.

rows.name: Go Low Profile
rows.price: Review $1,500. Cleanup $4,500. Move Kit $6,000. Upkeep $2,400 a year.
rows.scope: Mail, account and record coordination. A licensed agency runs searches where required.
rows.children: One household includes two adults and their children under 18.
rows.staff: Children and staff included in the Cleanup.
rows.county_records: County-record coordination remains subject to each office and the applicable law.
rows.turnaround: Cleanup planned over 4 to 8 weeks. Confirm the agreed timing in writing.
rows.accountability: Go Low Profile. Search agency named before the search where required.
rows.best_for: Best for a family seeking coordinated home-address work beyond broker requests.
rows.source: Go Low Profile published household offer
